title: Xolo Maridueña Talks Superstitions and New Film
seoTitle: Xolo Maridueña Talks Superstitions & Practical Magic 2
subtitle: The Actor Shares Details of His On-Set Debut with Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman
excerpt: Xolo Maridueña revealed superstitions he learned from his girlfriend and discussed his debut in Practical Magic 2, working alongside Bullock and Kidman.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Xolo Maridueña revealed that, upon joining "Practical Magic 2," he learned a superstition his girlfriend taught him, which is now part of his routine. The star also spoke about the supportive atmosphere he felt while working alongside Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman, who return as sisters Sally and Gillian Owens.

First Day on Set with Sandra and Nicole

On the first day of filming, Xolo shared that he felt nervous, but the scene he filmed helped alleviate his anxiety. He described the scene as "a little awkward," which allowed him to hide his trembling hands behind the character's facade.

Castmates' Support

Xolo described Sandra and Nicole as "very generous" and emphasized that their warmth helped reduce tension on set. He called them "the protagonists" of the film but said they welcomed him with open arms, which made the rest of the filming easier.

Joining the Franchise

For Xolo, being part of the "Practical Magic" universe meant taking on the responsibility of continuing a story that has had a fanbase since the original 1998 film. He compared the character transition to "passing the torch" to the new generation.

New Faces in the Cast

The actor praised Joey King and Maisie Williams, who are also part of the sequel. He said that "Joey and Maisie take their work very seriously" and that it was "an honor" to act alongside them.

Personal Superstitions

Xolo revealed that he avoids talking about projects before they are confirmed, as he doesn't want to jinx anything. He also shared that his girlfriend doesn't like to "cut the pole," a superstition where two people walk on opposite sides of a pole or post. Although he doesn't fully understand it, he has started following the practice and is testing his luck.

Belief in the Universe

When asked about the idea that people meet for a reason, Xolo responded that he believes everything happens for a reason and that he "totally" has faith in the power of the universe. For him, the most magical thing in life isn't witchcraft, but rather the family he has.

Press Tour Style

Xolo explained that he chose colorful and striking outfits for the press tour, inspired by the rich and beautiful aesthetic of the first film. He thanked his stylist for transforming his look for the event, as otherwise, he would have just worn clothes from his own wardrobe.

With information from HOLA.
